description: Single registry of every Tauri project in the monorepo: first-party apps and plugins, workspace-excluded or git-ignored ones; upstream checkouts live outside the repo (tools/config/upstream-sources.json). `bun run desktop:apps:check` scans the whole tree (git-ignored and workspace-excluded paths included, only target/node_modules/.git are skipped) and fails on any Tauri project missing here. tauri-sync derives its cargo gate and generated-file list from this file.

projects.note: Desktop agent console, the only desktop application. Embeds the prebuilt ui-dist bundle until @aphrody/app-ui joins the workspace. Also the Yolo desktop SDK host (--host-info, --runtime-host: former yolo-desktop), opens the M3 showcase window with --showcase (former m3-showcase; the Bun sidecar of m3/packages/app-ui/showcase serves UI and API) and hosts the real-webview shell e2e as the shell_e2e example (former aphrody-shell-tauri-e2e).
Tauri plugin: Drive daemon commands for aphrody-app.

@aphrody/scaffold: the single scaffolder (Tauri 3 shell, web/app/example templates, no-overwrite writer). Owns TAURI_3, mirrored from the root pins (tools/config/tauri-upstream.json mirrors); m3 new, m3-next-migrate and web-to-tauri write through it.
@aphrody/web-to-tauri: probes a site or project, plans remote/bundle/sidecar, generates a Tauri 3 project around aphrody-tauri-wrap and checks parity against the original.

Runtime plugin of web-to-tauri: navigation policy, downloads, loopback server with backend proxy (feature bundle, default), sidecar (std only). Reads src-tauri/wrap.json; shares policy-cases.json with the TypeScript policy. Also hosts the feature-gated (debug-bridge) Tauri 3 debug bridge aphrody_tauri_wrap::debug for aphrody-web and aphrody-mcp (aphrody_tauri_* tools): wraps the patched upstream tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge (screenshot through the CEF DevTools protocol) (patches/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge-0.13.0-tauri3.patch); loopback, per-process token, 0600 discovery file, debug builds only. Enabled in aphrody-model-view through its debug-bridge feature.

Migrates Next.js projects to Tauri 3 apps. Writes them through @aphrody/scaffold (the single scaffolder); TAURI_3 is re-exported from there. Its next16/tailwind4 codemods come from @aphrody/next-bun (the former Bun fork); mui-to-m3 stays here.
buildM3 / M3App Tauri webview layout; no Tauri dependency.
Tauri 3 plugin exposing native PTY shell sessions to the aphrody-shell-web webview client.

Vendored Tauri 3 fork (aphrody-tauri*, the 15 plugins aphrody-app registers, tauri-runtime-cef, CLI); upstream line and patches in tools/config/tauri-upstream.json. Its fixtures and templates are covered by this entry.
Serves the vendored Tauri CLIs in process (`aphrody tauri`, `aphrody create-tauri-app`).
Patched upstream MCP bridge plugin wrapped by aphrody-tauri-wrap (feature debug-bridge).
Desktop src-tauri template written by @aphrody/scaffold. Its tauri.conf.json is a template (frontendDist and $schema are filled at generation).
